answer_1.quote: Abstractive text summarization is a challenging Natural Language Generation (NLG) task, aiming to compress or rewrite a text into a short version while preserving its essential information.

answer_2.quote: We employ standard ROUGE metrics (Lin, 2004), including ROUGE-1 (R-1), ROUGE-2 (R-2), and ROUGE-L (R-L) to evaluate all the models.
